{"metadata":{"description":"an heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration skill designed for dsh","id":"gh:1335945062","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-octo","slug":"tokentopo-ai/dsh-octo","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"an heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration skill designed for dsh"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-octo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Prerequisites ·
Install ·
What It Does ·
How It Works ·
Documentation ·
License"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Deepseek Harness (dsh) natively supports headless invocation of Claude Code and Codex as
subagents t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"hrough its built-in subagent backends, and these subagents can reuse the local account
login state a"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"nd the coding plans that come with the accounts. For example, if you have a Claude
Code Max plan, yo"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"u can have dsh call Fable-5 as a subagent."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Inspired by this, I designed this skill specifically for dsh, with these ideas in mind:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Use built-in capabilities wherever possible for the most seamless invocation of heterogeneous
suba"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"gents.
- Make dsh aware that it can call subagents, so it can aggregate multiple agents into greater"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"
intelligence.
- Design dedicated multi-agent workflows for different stages—such as planning, codin"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"g, and
acceptance—to achieve high-quality collaboration."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`.
- A `deepseek-official` provider configured for the main dsh model.
- Node.js, n"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"pm, and a pnpm environment available to `dsh plugin`.
- Claude Code and Codex installed and signed i"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n locally, with active coding-plan subscriptions
on the corresponding accounts."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"dsh-octo currently targets dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`. Install it from a local tarball so dsh can resolve
the "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"bundle and all of its dependencies:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Replace `web` with the profile you use, then restart it."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Once installed, use dsh exactly as usual: describe your task in normal conversation. No trigger
phra"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"se, subagent selection, or stage-by-stage command is required. The skill starts multi-agent
collabor"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ation only when it is useful."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## What It Does"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"dsh-octo is a **prompt-only orchestration contract**, not an orchestration engine: it ships no
workf"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"low runtime and does not depend on ultracode or dsh Dynamic Workflow capabilities. The
bundle only i"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"nstalls dependencies, registers the skill, and enables the delegation tools; every
routing and stage"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" decision is made by the main agent as it follows the skill's written
instructions."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"It only activates itself for tasks that genuinely need multi-stage collaboration:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Activates** — tasks that need a plan → code → review pipeline (with optional experiments),
or th"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"at benefit from comparing multiple solutions or an independent review pass.
- **Stays out of the way"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"** — single-point fixes, direct Q&A;, and small changes that don't need a
design decision. These con"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"tinue on the main agent's usual path, with no overhead."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"When it does activate, the main agent delegates to a fixed pool of official dsh subagent
backends, o"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"activate, the main agent delegates to a fixed pool of official dsh subagent
backends, one per stage:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Agent | Composition | Delegated tool |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `fable` | Claude Code + Fable (xhigh) | `subagent_claude_code` |
| `gpt-5.6-sol` | Codex + gpt-5.6"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"-sol (xhigh) | `subagent_codex` |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | DSH child + deepseek-v4-pro | `subagent_deep"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"seek_v4_pro` |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | DSH child + deepseek-v4-flash | `subagent_deepseek_v4_flash` "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"eek_v4_pro` |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | DSH child + deepseek-v4-flash | `subagent_deepseek_v4_flash` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A typical run walks through:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. **Plan** — `fable` drafts an initial plan; four `deepseek-v4-pro` subagents draft it again in
par"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"allel from different angles (architecture, implementation path, risk/testing, resources);
`deepseek-"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"v4-flash` synthesizes all five into a final plan.
2. **Code** — for a Git project, four `deepseek-v4"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"-pro` subagents implement the plan in parallel,
isolated `git worktree`s; `gpt-5.6-sol` reads all fo"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ur implementations and diffs, then merges
them into the final change in the main worktree.
3. **Revi"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ew** — `gpt-5.6-sol` checks the implementation against the original task (not just
against the plan)"},{"id":"p23s7","text":", runs tests, fixes any bugs it finds, and verifies every "fixed/changed"
claim with an executable c"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"ommand before signing off.
4. **Experiment** (only when needed) — the main agent runs the experiment"},{"id":"p23s9","text":" itself and hands the
results to `fable` for analysis."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Every handoff between agents is written to a file under `artifacts/` (`input/`, `plan/`, `impl/`,
`r"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"eview/`, `experiments/`) rather than passed through shared conversation context, since
heterogeneous"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" agents don't share context with each other. If a subagent is unavailable, times
out, or is rejected"},{"id":"p24s4","text":", the main agent takes over that step itself instead of blocking the task, and
the handoff records t"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"his so the collaboration stays inspectable after the fact."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"dsh-octo is installed as a static Cordis bundle: a packaged skill provider plus the official
`codex`"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" and `claude-code` product providers and their four `subagent_*` tools, added directly to
the select"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ed dsh profile. Installing from the tarball (rather than `dsh plugin add .` or a plain
Git checkout)"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" matters here — it is what keeps the package's `files` allowlist in effect, so only
`index.js`, `cor"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"dis.patch.yml`, `SKILL.md`, `assets/`, `docs/`, and the READMEs are exposed as the
skill's resource "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"base, and none of this repository's private development material (`artifacts/`,
`AGENTS.md`, `local_"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"docs/`) leaks into it. See Deployment for the full
install/migrate/rollback procedure."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Authentication is never copied into this project: Claude Code and Codex keep using their own
local l"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ogin state and coding-plan entitlements, and dsh-octo only calls the official backends
that already "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"own that authentication."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The following documents ship with the package and cover installation, the delegation contract,
and o"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"perational detail beyond this README:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Deployment — installing the bundle, cleaning up old configuration,
verification, and rollback.
- A"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"gent call manual — delegation tool contracts, prompt structure,
parallelism, and retry policy.
- Art"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ifact handoff — directory layout, naming, and the
minimal-read/worktree boundaries between agents.
-"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" Config and secrets — credential sources, model routing, and the
boundaries for CLI fallback.
- Acce"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ptance checklist — installation, workflow, security, and
cleanup checks."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"This project is currently distributed as `UNLICENSED`; no open-source license is granted."}],"truncated":false}
